items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder: a flat soft fill (separator tone, square corners, no cell grid) under one soft shimmer band that translates linearly left to right (1.6 s loop); optional framed 1 px inset frame. role=presentation by default; SkeletonGroup is the single status. Reduced: the band pulses in opacity; off: still.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The grid scan is a CSS gradient and a Web Animation; no original assets are used. v4: the shimmer is a linear translateX band (was a stepped down-scan). Migration (breaking): the static tiny-cell grid background is removed in favour of a flat fill (no seams); the default radius is square; new optional framed prop.
